oracle: independent Decimal replay of the exported source journal; production MERGE code is not imported

scenarios.name: initial load/backfill
scenarios.expected: Orders, payment events, per-order controls, counts, keys, and NUMERIC totals match the as-of oracle.

scenarios.name: exact batch replay
scenarios.source_sequence: same immutable range, bytes, manifest generation, and object generation
scenarios.expected: Observable NO_OP; Silver, Gold, and checkpoint values are unchanged.

scenarios.name: single-key update
scenarios.expected: One effective current value per key; exact Decimal change in the affected order control.

scenarios.name: explicit tombstone
scenarios.source_sequence: payment tombstone plus order tombstone policy case
scenarios.expected: Tombstone is explicit; order deletion does not delete payment events; absence in a delta never deletes.

scenarios.name: late business-date correction
scenarios.source_sequence: higher sequence with corrected older order/payment business date
scenarios.expected: Only affected order controls move to the corrected business period and match the oracle.

scenarios.name: same source timestamp
scenarios.source_sequence: multiple events for one key sharing source_updated_at
scenarios.expected: Deterministic highest change_seq wins; no skipped event or ambiguous MERGE source.

scenarios.name: corrupt, partial, or schema drift
scenarios.source_sequence: altered Parquet bytes, incomplete manifest, duplicate-conflict, and unknown schema version
scenarios.expected: Fail closed and quarantine/record failure; previously published Gold and checkpoint stay unchanged.

scenarios.name: failure after Silver MERGE before checkpoint
scenarios.source_sequence: payment W5P0004 update followed by injected failure inside the BigQuery transaction after Silver mutations
scenarios.expected: Transaction rollback keeps prior Silver, Gold, and checkpoint visible; a later retry converges without duplicate money.

scenarios.name: retroactive source event/backfill
scenarios.source_sequence: new sequence with older source_updated_at plus explicit bounded old range
scenarios.expected: Journal sequence captures the late delivery; backfill does not rewind checkpoint or overwrite newer Silver state.

scenarios.name: failure and operator recovery
scenarios.source_sequence: W5P0004 amount update, injected pre-publication failure, and manual safe replay
scenarios.expected: Durable FAILED code and attempt history remain; bounded recovery publishes exact oracle state.
